summary: Completed testing of Armarios IA features. Backend: 10/11 tests passed (91%). Frontend: All 6 features verified and working. Fixed a bug in the IA configure endpoint where response was not being parsed correctly.

minor.issue: Intermittent 'La IA no generó respuesta' error - LLM sometimes returns None on first call
minor.notes: This is an intermittent issue with the Gemini API. Retry logic could be added.

updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed IA configure endpoint to properly parse LLM response
seed_data_creation: Test projects created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Armarios IA features fully implemented and tested. IA Configuration uses gemini-3-flash-preview model, IA Render uses gemini-3-pro-image-preview model. Both endpoints are working but IA Configure has intermittent response issues.

ia_configuration.details: IA modal opens, accepts text description, calls /api/armarios/ia/configure endpoint, applies configuration to wardrobe. Intermittent response issue noted.

ia_render.details: Render modal opens, generates photorealistic wardrobe image using Gemini, displays image with download button

editable_despiece.details: Despiece modal shows editable table with move up/down, duplicate, delete buttons. Row selection enables inline editing.

despiece_add_accessory.details: '+ AÑADIR ACCESORIO' button adds new row to the accessories list

save_load_projects.details: PROYECTOS modal shows saved projects list, GUARDAR button saves current project, projects can be loaded and deleted

armarios_header_buttons.ia_button: Purple gradient button with Sparkles icon, data-testid='armarios-ia-config-btn'
armarios_header_buttons.render_button: Cyan gradient button with Image icon, data-testid='armarios-render-btn'
armarios_header_buttons.proyectos_button: White/transparent button with FolderOpen icon, data-testid='armarios-proyectos-btn'
armarios_header_buttons.despiece_button: Orange button with Scissors icon, data-testid='armarios-despiece-btn'
armarios_header_buttons.guardar_button: Green button with Save icon, data-testid='armarios-guardar-btn'

render_modal.config_display: Shows dimensions, color, door type, modules

despiece_modal.editable_table: Columns: #, ACCIÓN, CÓDIGO, NOMBRE, CATEGORÍA, DIMENSIONES, CANT., P.UNIT., TOTAL
despiece_modal.action_buttons: Move up/down, Duplicate, Delete per row

proyectos_modal.project_list: Shows saved projects with name, client, dimensions, price, date
